{{Quote|I don't know about you, Master Windu, but Das struck me as a ''rather rude'' man.|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]]|<ref name="Hypermatters">{{TCWComicCite|6.40|Hypermatters}}</ref>}}
'''Volan Das''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] operating during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He worked for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], leading an [[Raid on the Republic hypermatter refinery|attack]] on an [[unidentified Republic hypermatter refinery]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The [[Volan Das's starship|starship]] he owned was used during the attack.
